caelan_gearblade.name: Mira’s Blade
caelan_gearblade.description: Mira’s gift blade channels Caelan’s Aether through the installed gem selected by its rotating gear guard. Originally fitted with a Blue Water focus, its spare sockets accept additional elemental gems.

red_focus_gem.name: Red Focus Gem
red_focus_gem.description: The stable red core recovered from Embravyr. Installed in Mira’s Blade, it focuses Fire-aspected Aether for Flame Edge.

white_focus_gem.name: White Focus Gem
white_focus_gem.description: The stable white core recovered from Nivareth. Installed in Mira’s Blade, it focuses Ice-aspected Aether for Ice Edge.

potion.name: Potion
potion.description: A healing draught that restores 100 HP to one living character.

ether.name: Ether
ether.description: Restores 15 MP to one living character.

revival_salts.name: Revival Salts
revival_salts.description: Revives one KO character with 25% of their maximum HP.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Allows the party to escape a battle that permits fleeing.

rest_kit.name: Rest Kit
rest_kit.description: A compact bundle of supplies for resting. Where it can be used has yet to be established.
